summary: Given i.i.d. ±1 symmetric variables X_n and independent Geometric(1/2) variables Y_n, define Z_n = X_n Y_n Y_{n+1} and S_n = sum of Z_i; determine whether Z_1 and Z_2 are independent, compute E(S_n) and Var(S_n), and prove S_n/n converges in distribution to E(Z_1) (a law of large numbers via Chebyshev).
